svg.title: cns 9 discovery loop
svg.desc: Proposed CNS loop. Integrity checks are separate from rival-indexed world-response predictions. Locked predictions and audit outputs flow one way into sealed evaluation; gold outcomes never enter runtime. Candidate inadequacy can end unresolved.

g.text: Revise rivals only as new evidence warrants
